item.title: Community group event provides $3,000 aid to Wilmington woman amid fiancé’s transplant recovery
item.description: NEW HANOVER COUNTY (WWAY) — When Vanessa Vaccaro moved here with her fiancé Steven McCauslin, they knew no one. “I had just moved here; my fiancé had gotten a new job in the area, and I didn’t know anybody,” said Vaccaro. item.title: Wilmington celebrates grand re-opening of roadway after $15M upgrade
item.description: WILMINGTON, NC (WWAY-TV) – The city of Wilmington celebrated their grand re-opening of Fifth Avenue on Wednesday. item.title: 15-year-old Columbus County girl has been found by Columbus County Sheriff’s Office
item.description: The Columbus County Sheriff’s Office is actively conducting a search and rescue operation for 15-year-old Jettie Edwards, who has autism.

item.title: Trump gives a partisan prime-time address insisting the economy is stronger than many voters feel
item.description: President Donald Trump delivered a politically charged speech Wednesday carried live in prime time on network television, seeking to pin the blame for economic challenges on Democrats while announcing he is sending a $1,776 bonus check to U.S. troops for Christmas.

item.title: US government admits role in causing helicopter-plane collision that killed 67 in Washington
item.description: The U.S. government admitted Wednesday that the actions of an air traffic controller and Army helicopter pilot played a role in causing a collision last January between an airliner and a Black Hawk near the nation's capital, killing 67 people.

item.title: 15 year old Columbus County girl found after going missing for nearly 24 hours
item.description: 15-year-old Jettie Edwards, who is autistic, went missing from her grandmother's home, located in the 9000 block of Hallsboro Road South, on Tuesday night.
